1stgenrex: Casimir Stgenrex arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in T-S8 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Casimir Stgenrex kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand. A letter from home found Casimir Stgenrex before the night shift. Casimir Stgenrex folded it small and kept it close.

Asked what he will do after the war, Casimir Stgenrex said: 'Be a schoolteacher in Halden. And never complain about anything, ever again.' A letter from home found Casimir Stgenrex before the night shift. Casimir Stgenrex folded it small and kept it close. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached T-S8 with the rations. Casimir Stgenrex ate while listening to the revised orders.

Casimir Stgenrex sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway. A letter from home found Casimir Stgenrex before the night shift. Casimir Stgenrex folded it small and kept it close.
aim0hh: Teodor "Hollow" Aim stepped off the supply cart at T-F19 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Teodor "Hollow" Aim added a leak above the man's head in pencil. Mail came up the line with a letter for Teodor "Hollow" Aim. Teodor "Hollow" Aim read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Teodor "Hollow" Aim walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Bram Amanatidis and Teodor "Hollow" Aim cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button. Mail came up the line with a letter for Teodor "Hollow" Aim. Teodor "Hollow" Aim read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
commanderchris__: The new runner gave his name as Otto Commanderchr. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

Otto Commanderchr and Anselm "Parson" Rock divided a parcel using the lid of a tin as scales. The final crumb required a second opinion. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Otto Commanderchr shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Otto Commanderchr tipped water from a boot and a small beetle climbed out. At least one passenger had enjoyed the crossing.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Otto Commanderchr. The men named it the Parson and said it had chosen him.

the Parson the crow follows Otto Commanderchr along the trench now. When the Parson flies off, men duck. They are usually right to. After the loss of Hill 304, Otto Commanderchr helped stack spare sandbags at S-F7. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Somebody in S-F7 wanted to shoot the Parson for the pot. Otto Commanderchr stood in front of the rifle. The matter has been dropped.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F7 and grazed Otto Commanderchr's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Casimir Schradog of the Hegemony (@schradog2).
Otto Commanderchr is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
Otto Commanderchr and Cyril "Mud" Sann share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into S-F7. Otto Commanderchr has learned to walk bent double.

Otto Commanderchr dreamt he was back in Marrow Fen, working as a schoolteacher. He woke up and said nothing all morning. The clerk counted the names twice. Otto Commanderchr is number 149 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Otto Commanderchr stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Otto Commanderchr gave Gideon Wolves the last match in the trench. Gideon used it to light a candle so that Otto could finish a letter.
cornyfuckmagee: Leopold "Ash" Cornyfuckmag found a place in N-F10 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Leopold "Ash" Cornyfuckmag stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Leopold "Ash" Cornyfuckmag taught Hugo Dbd three words in the language of home. Hugo uses all three at the wrong moment, every day.
dan1hand: After 10 days of war, T-F19 had a place for everything. On Day 10, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Isidor "Spark" Hand.

A bullet hit Isidor "Spark" Hand's belt buckle at T-F19 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Dietrich Rmr of the Concord (@rmr7015). News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Isidor "Spark" Hand during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

The men at T-F19 heard Isidor "Spark" Hand call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Dietrich Rmr of the Concord (@rmr7015). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Isidor "Spark" Hand fell at T-F19 and never moved again. Shot by Dietrich Rmr of the Concord (@rmr7015).
Ulrich Hand asked about Isidor "Spark" Hand on arriving at T-F19. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
fidel_del_toro: Casimir Toro stepped off the supply cart at S-F12 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Casimir Toro answered the first call, number 30 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
News of the loss of Verdel Ridge reached S-F12 with the rations. Casimir Toro ate while listening to the revised orders.
A bullet hit the sandbag beside Casimir Toro. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway.
Casimir Toro of the Hegemony and Bram Tephydraws of the Concord watched a broken branch near Verdel Ridge all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.

Casimir Toro bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Casimir Toro helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Dawn watch. Casimir Toro put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Albin Zgz, grazed.
In the fog a figure walked along the parapet of S-F12. When Casimir Toro challenged it, there was nobody there.
Casimir Toro practised asking for bread in the local language. The dugout supplied an audience and several confidently incorrect pronunciations.
A local carter understood Casimir Toro's request for bread, then explained that the same sentence sounded very much like a request for a beard.
A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at S-F12. Casimir Toro was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Bastian Lynxxactual of the Concord (@lynxxactual).

The House of Toro sent Nils Toro after Casimir Toro. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Nils Toro was number 30. He still remembers how stiff the colonel's glove felt.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Nils Toro waited for that to change. When it did, Karel Themimicches was badly wounded. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at S-F12 changed before the cheering ended. Nils Toro shouldered another load.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Nils Toro fired, and Jakub Deeznut was grazed.
j_u_s10: Karel Jus left a younger sister who sends drawings behind in Rosenau and came up the line with a lock of hair in a matchbox. The men noticed at once that he tells terrible jokes.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Karel Jus kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Karel Jus found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'. Karel Jus got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 963. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Karel Jus stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Karel Jus is Lance Corporal now. At supper, a recruit waited for him to sit before taking a place. He noticed.
joe_mcm09: Day 9: Pavel Mcm reached R-C12 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Pavel Mcm wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Dawn watch. Pavel Mcm put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Emil "Crow" Mangotto, grazed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Pavel Mcm is number 676. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Pavel Mcm stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Pavel Mcm waited for that to change. When it did, Edmund Aquaboy was grazed.
just_sharky24: The new rifleman gave his name as Norbert Sharky. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Norbert Sharky shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Norbert Sharky. The men named it the Parson and said it had chosen him.
A bullet clipped Norbert Sharky's helmet at R-F6 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Clement Snake of the Hegemony (@jake_the_snake6424).

Norbert Sharky no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A letter from home found Norbert Sharky before the night shift. Norbert Sharky folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Norbert Sharky watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

the Parson the crow follows Norbert Sharky along the trench now. When the Parson flies off, men duck. They are usually right to. A letter from home found Norbert Sharky before the night shift. Norbert Sharky folded it small and kept it close.
A man asked Norbert Sharky to describe Marrow Fen without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.

A round went through the rim of Norbert Sharky's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Ivo "Rabbit" Beck of the Hegemony (@brandon_marc_beck). Norbert Sharky fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp was grazed. A letter from home found Norbert Sharky before the night shift. Norbert Sharky folded it small and kept it close.

Norbert Sharky was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-F6. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Ivo "Rabbit" Beck of the Hegemony (@brandon_marc_beck). Norbert Sharky was killed on watch at R-F6. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Ivo "Rabbit" Beck of the Hegemony (@brandon_marc_beck).
Wendel Sharky came to the front because his cousin Norbert Sharky never came home. He carries his mother's thimble.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Wendel Sharky was hit hard in the fight at R-F6 before anyone could fire. The raider was Konrad Cbour of the Hegemony. Raider: Konrad Cbour of the Hegemony (@cbour57_). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Wendel Sharky kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

A bullet struck Wendel Sharky below the ribs at R-F6. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Dorian Heitoralmeid of the Hegemony (@heitoralmeida314). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Wendel Sharky is number 188. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Wendel Sharky stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Wendel Sharky died waiting. The men at R-F6 have not stopped talking about it.

Ivo Sharky asked about Wendel Sharky on arriving at R-F6. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. Orders came through: Ivo Sharky is a rifleman now. He handed in his old kit and kept only his mother's thimble.
kapitancray: Nils Kapitancray reported to R-C8 with his brother's pocket watch sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Nils Kapitancray during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Nils Kapitancray carried in the drummer, who lied about his age to enlist. the drummer kept asking whether his mother would be told. The clerk counted the names twice. Nils Kapitancray is number 681 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Nils Kapitancray helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
the drummer has a fever. Nils Kapitancray sits with him after every shift and reads to him from a book with the last pages missing.
korathon1: On Day 11 Cyril "Mole" Korathon took a post at P-F6 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He hates silence more than shelling, and the men liked him for it. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Cyril "Mole" Korathon folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Cyril "Mole" Korathon lost a boot in the trench. Rafael Gundam found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word. A letter from home found Cyril "Mole" Korathon before the night shift. Cyril "Mole" Korathon folded it small and kept it close.
m.w_1254: Zeno "Shadow" Mw came up on Day 9 carrying news from Brennmoor. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Zeno "Shadow" Mw fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Roland Rudransh was grazed. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Zeno "Shadow" Mw watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Hugo Thegreat and Zeno "Shadow" Mw found a cat in the ruins at Saint-Ash crossroads and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Shadow. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Zeno "Shadow" Mw answered to number 750. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Zeno "Shadow" Mw wrote to an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Zeno "Shadow" Mw had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Henrik Dmt was grazed.
meme4cheese: "You're late," said the corporal when Matthias Cheese arrived on Day 10. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Matthias Cheese gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Matthias Cheese watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Matthias Cheese lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
mg42svt40m1919type99k98k: Oskar "Rabbit" Type came from Oakmere, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Oskar "Rabbit" Type watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Oskar "Rabbit" Type fished it out by feel and then had to wash again. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Oskar "Rabbit" Type read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Oskar "Rabbit" Type had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Hugo Karl crossed it, Oskar "Rabbit" Type fired. Hugo Karl was grazed.
mouthfullofrocks: On Day 9 Albin Mouthfullofr took a post at S-R5 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He shares cigarettes but never smokes, and the men liked him for it.

Albin Mouthfullofr was hit in the forearm at S-R5. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple of the Concord (@kamdensipple). On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Albin Mouthfullofr wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Albin Mouthfullofr's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Albin Mouthfullofr could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
In the rear quarters, Albin Mouthfullofr played football against the sappers. The ball was a sandbag stuffed with straw. The sappers cheated.
nico.theanimator: They issued Yann Theanimator a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a bullet that missed him in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Yann Theanimator jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Valentin Thky. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@haydnburrell_9thky) Yann Theanimator jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Zeno "Mud" Jwger. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@jwger87) The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Yann Theanimator watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Yann Theanimator carried three men out of S-C12 on a stretcher. One of them thanked him. Two could not. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Yann Theanimator answered to number 706. Grey Mill is lost. Yann Theanimator heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Yann Theanimator dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.
patatas_ogkratas: Norbert "Crow" Ogkratas walked into R-S2 on Day 8 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Norbert "Crow" Ogkratas and Albin "Spark" Bananarail carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Norbert "Crow" Ogkratas wrote to his mother, who writes every Sunday that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Shellfire stopped the carrying party at a trench junction. Norbert "Crow" Ogkratas waited under a load that got heavier by the minute. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Norbert "Crow" Ogkratas answered to number 562. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Norbert "Crow" Ogkratas stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

The men at R-S2 heard Norbert "Crow" Ogkratas call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Teodor Bangarang of the Hegemony (@bangarang_._._). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Norbert "Crow" Ogkratas fell at R-S2 and never moved again. Shot by Teodor Bangarang of the Hegemony (@bangarang_._._).
Another member of the House of Ogkratas reached the line: Isidor Ogkratas. He asked where Norbert "Crow" Ogkratas had slept, then chose a different corner.
rusty_hanginbang: Clement Hanginbang joined the replacements on Day 11. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Across from P-F21, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Clement Hanginbang saw it. Marek Limaecho was grazed.
saruulraj: Wendel "Owl" Saruulraj came from Kesselby, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Wendel "Owl" Saruulraj looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them. The transfer made Wendel "Owl" Saruulraj a stretcher bearer. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Wendel "Owl" Saruulraj woke with his hair frozen to the sandbags. The cook brought tea so hot it hurt. Nobody complained. Mail came up the line with a letter for Wendel "Owl" Saruulraj. Wendel "Owl" Saruulraj read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into Q-F4. Wendel "Owl" Saruulraj has learned to walk bent double.
Wendel "Owl" Saruulraj and Casimir Toz carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
swilikens: Tobias Swilikens arrived with the Day 12 draft, carrying a key to a house that is no longer there and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
the_jthompson_: "You're late," said the corporal when Florian Jthompson arrived on Day 10. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Ivo Cko and Florian Jthompson made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at U-F12 changed before the cheering ended. Florian Jthompson shouldered another load.
Florian Jthompson fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Roland Bfitzy, now grazed.
tuckerdesaveur: After 9 days of war, S-R1 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Roland "Mole" Tuckerdesave.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Roland "Mole" Tuckerdesave wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Dorian "Rabbit" Akind (Hegemony) and Roland "Mole" Tuckerdesave (Concord) watched each other through the same loophole at the Drowned Farm for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why. Grey Mill is lost. Roland "Mole" Tuckerdesave heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Roland "Mole" Tuckerdesave fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-R1. Leopold Shallowcrow was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
tyler.zenga: Marek Zenga came up on Day 9 carrying news from Stoneyford. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Marek Zenga fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Walter "Crow" Viti was grazed. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Marek Zenga stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A parcel from home held a comb. Marek Zenga has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought. A letter from home found Marek Zenga before the night shift. Marek Zenga folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In Q-S8, Marek Zenga listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Marek Zenga of the Concord and Isidor "Parson" Potvin of the Hegemony have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at Blackwater Canal. It is getting crowded.
w0lfer2210: Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer was a blacksmith in Millbank until the posters went up. He came to S-F3 with a rosary of rough beads, and within a day the whole squad knew that he reads the same book over and over.

Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer offered a spare button for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity. A letter from home found Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer before the night shift. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer folded it small and kept it close.

Wiring party. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at S-F3, and everyone came back. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Jakub "Shadow" Camper, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. A letter from home found Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer before the night shift. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer folded it small and kept it close. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot. A letter from home found Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer before the night shift. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer folded it small and kept it close.

Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Bram Tephydraws crossed it, Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer fired. Bram Tephydraws was grazed. A letter from home found Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer before the night shift. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer folded it small and kept it close.

Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Ivo Boi, badly wounded. A letter from home found Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer before the night shift. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer folded it small and kept it close.

The water jacket hissed as Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Jakub "Shadow" Camper was badly wounded. Brass cases piled up around Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer's boots at S-F3. Out of all those rounds, one found Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy, grazed. A letter from home found Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer before the night shift. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer folded it small and kept it close.

The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-F3 changed before the cheering ended. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer shouldered another load. A letter from home found Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer before the night shift. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer folded it small and kept it close.

Wendel Bartdrent of the Concord shouted across the wire at the Sunken Road, asking for the football scores from home. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer of the Hegemony shouted them back. Some of them were even true. A letter from home found Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer before the night shift. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer folded it small and kept it close. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer is number 268. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Victory at Grey Mill. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer let himself talk about leave for the first time in days. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.' Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer was invited to the Officers' Mess for keeping the front supplied. The colonel poured a real coffee and raised his cup: 'The front does not forget its friends.' A Jack Russell terrier came up the line with the ration party and would not leave Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer's side. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer named the dog Bobby. The sergeant pretended not to see.

Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch. A letter from home found Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer before the night shift. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer folded it small and kept it close.
youngmoneyjakovitch: Oskar "Ghost" Youngmoneyja arrived with the Day 11 draft, carrying a stub of a pencil and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Oskar "Ghost" Youngmoneyja watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
An empty jam tin became Oskar "Ghost" Youngmoneyja's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.
